title: anisomeles albiflora
intro: Anisomeles albiflora, commonly known as 'White Flowered Anisomeles', is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to tropical regions of Asia. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, providing relief from respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its expectorant properties, which help in loosening and coughing up mucus. The health benefits of Anisomeles albiflora include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in soothing skin irritations and preventing infections. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
